2.4 “Documentation” means the standard user, technical, operational or descriptive documentation made available by DataVision for the relevant Product or Service.

 

2.5 “Products” means any hardware, equipment, devices, assemblies, components or other tangible items supplied by DataVision.

 

2.6 “Professional Services” means implementation, installation, configuration, integration, commissioning, consulting, training, support, maintenance, development or other services provided by DataVision.

 

2.7 “Project” means any agreed implementation, development, customization, delivery, proof of concept, pilot or similar engagement.

 

2.8 “SaaS Services” means any software-as-a-service, cloud, hosted, subscription-based, API-based or remotely accessible service made available by DataVision.

 

2.9 “Services” means any Professional Services and/or SaaS Services supplied by DataVision.

 

2.10 “Software” means any software, application, platform, code, model, algorithm, interface, script, library, tool, workflow or similar digital component supplied, licensed or made available by DataVision, whether on-premises, embedded, downloadable, hosted or cloud-based.

2.12 “Subscription Term” means the period during which the Customer is authorized to use the relevant SaaS Service or subscription-based Software.

 

2.13 “System” means an integrated solution consisting of hardware, software, components, modules, documentation and/or services delivered by DataVision.

 

2.14 “Third-Party Components” means any third-party software, hardware, tools, libraries, hosting services, open-source software or other components not owned by DataVision.

(c) demonstrate that the alleged non-conformity constitutes a material deviation from the agreed specification.

8.7 For SaaS Services and standard Software, unless a formal acceptance procedure is expressly agreed, the relevant Services and Software are deemed accepted upon provisioning of access or first productive use.
